measurementDefinitions.httpAcknowledgement: Browser performance.now immediately before authenticated fetch to after response JSON/receipt validation; includes browser-emulated latency and HTTP/auth/repository/projection costs
measurementDefinitions.repositoryResolutionToPeerPaintOpportuni: One coordinator monotonic clock: command repository promise resolution after its transaction returns, to an authorized different-node observer binding after matching on-screen SVG text and two requestAnimationFrames. Includes CDP binding delivery; an upper bound on a paint opportunity, not database COMMIT instant or physical pixel/monitor latency
measurementDefinitions.guestPublication: Same resolution-to-two-rAF observation for an ordinary private object explicitly published by the facilitator; measured in the Bearer-only guest canvas served by the other node
measurementDefinitions.initialRender: Browser navigation performance.now to expected complete SVG object count and visible authorized text plus two requestAnimationFrames; sequential fresh browser contexts, server/OS caches warm after the first navigation
measurementDefinitions.navigationFrameInterval: Consecutive browser rAF timestamps while real pointer hand-pan gestures cross the already-rendered mixed scene; not presented-frame GPU timing or reference-device FPS
measurementDefinitions.reconnect: Coordinator time from enabling the offline peer context network until both its latest authorized matching text plus two rAF and a new stream request
measurementDefinitions.stalledConsumerAcknowledgement: HTTP acknowledgement samples while an additional authorized raw TCP stream deliberately does not consume its response body; checks isolation, not a forced worst-case backpressure cutoff
measurementDefinitions.repositoryProfiling: Optional CANVAS_COLLAB_PROFILE=true instance/SQL/pool observations during measured write-and-peer-paint waves only; setup/warm-up and operations begun before that window are excluded. Monotonic client elapsed times, numeric correlation and fixed method/SQL categories only. CANVAS_COLLAB_PROFILE_MAX_SAMPLES bounds retained completions (default20000,max100000); truncation and in-flight observations are disclosed. No authority cache or production behavior changes; gates remain independent.

limitations: Opt-in observer overhead; compare equally instrumented variants and confirm the end-to-end result with profiling disabled
Fixed origins classify the initiating HTTP route or stream callback, not request completion timing; stream/outbox work carries no handshake request ordinal
Only SQL/pool work inside wrapped Canvas repository methods is attributed; HTTP credential/policy work outside those methods is still excluded
Client-observed SQL elapsed time includes driver/network/lock waits and is not database CPU or an exact server COMMIT timestamp
Rows are driver rowCount totals, including writes; row contents and byte sizes are never inspected
Samples retain the first maxSamples completions across all kinds; dropped counts disclose truncation and retained quantiles can be biased
Operations that cross the window end are censored; inFlightAtStop counts these incomplete observations
Nested method wall durations overlap; direct SQL belongs to its innermost method and durations must not be added across nested spans
Pool pressure is sampled at acquisition boundaries; reported maxima are across individual node pools, not their sum or a continuous high-water measurement

interpretation: All reports are local complete correctness observations; failed smoke outcomes are retained.
Per-run p95 distributions and ranges are not a formal tail-latency guarantee. Small sample counts remain diagnostic.
The old and candidate differ only in server stream scheduling. PDF export optimization is in both. The same verified production browser build is reused.
Profiling includes partial measured-window completions, boundary-only pool pressure and censored in-flight work. Nested durations overlap and must not be summed.
Source fingerprints include server, DB, contracts and harness; the durable field serverAndHarnessSourceSha256 is the unchanged raw report value.
The paused TCP consumer is isolation evidence, not a saturation/cutoff test.
Media uses tiny synthetic images; two API nodes share one process; physical devices, staging topology, realistic media and long-duration soak remain unqualified.

hostedResults.mobileWebKit: runner shutdown signal; no reported assertion or per-test trace
hostedResults.secretScan: 3 generic-api-key false positives on two public source fingerprints

gitleaksValidation.configSelfScanInterpretation: Default scanner excludes its own config; syntax/behavior are validated by the other scans.
